verdict: Yes, if you have a real product innovation. Woolah from Sivasagar in Assam pitched the world's first bagless tea dip on Shark Tank India Season 4 and got a deal. It showed that even tea, a crowded category, rewards a genuinely new product.
angle: Assam's tea gardens give founders access to good tea at source. Innovation in format, such as bagless dips, compressed tea or cold brew, makes the product stand out on the shelf. Patents or trade secrets help keep copycats at bay.
